title: Cross-vendor verifier for explain research and critique
reason: P32 verifies research and critiques chapters on a different Claude model (Sonnet checks Opus). A check on another vendor's model (e.g. the GPT-6 agents routed through opencodex) would share fewer blind spots, but it is paid vendor-API use, so its plan needs the operator's approval. The operator chose to leave it out of P32 and defer it.
